title: ZZWF07 8-round AES-192 Related-key differential-linear / eight

target.description: AES-192 first8 rounds, finalMC omitted. 18 guessed bytes:8 bytes k0 and10 bytes k8. No independently quantified192-bit-master-key completion at this budget.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown master keys with second XOR pattern ((a,0,0,0),0,(a,0,0,0),0,0,0), a chosen nonzero.
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen plaintext observations under two unknown keys with the stated XOR relation.
assumptions: The literal procedure selects maximum absolute parity deviation among subkey candidates; source component-count bias and Matsui rule of thumb do not quantify all candidate-ranking failures.

The exact11/5440 bias is a count over uniformly weighted compatible intermediate tuples, not a proof that every fixed related AES key pair induces that distribution. After SR and equivalent-key addition the signed bias is multiplied by (-1)^{lambda dot (Delta w[13] XOR Delta w[10])}; its absolute model bias is unchanged.

time.note: Section6.1 uses m=2^53: two terms 2^166 one-round encryptions and one 2^166 two-round decryption term. Sum divided by8 gives 2^165 eight-round encryption units; data 2*m*2^64=2^118.

data.note: Aggregate 2*m*2^64=2^118 chosen plaintext blocks across both keys, m=2^53 structures per key. Final retained-pair count 2^-32*m=2^21 is not query count.

memory.note: Literal Section6 step5c array of 2^144 counters; counter width unspecified. Outer 8-byte k0 loop and 18-byte counter indexing in 5d.v leave implementation/accounting ambiguity; do not replace it with an optimized 2^80 array or byte count.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

success.description: No numerical success probability for the recorded partial-key ranking output is supplied. The source uses approximately2^-9 bias and the Matsui rule8*(2^-9)^-2≈2^21 pairs; a sample-size rule is not a finite-budget success probability. The six conditional filter fractions describe pair counts, not independent recovery events; retain the existing counter/index and outer-loop scope. No later-paper95% rate is borrowed.

components.description: Equation6 (or the shifted Equation10 construction with its own key relation and input conditions): the designated two byte differences are equal and nonzero at the specified boundary. This deterministic conditioned relation is not key-ranking success.

Equation7: exact count for uniformly sampled compatible pre-key-offset tuples. The bias is11/5440 (about2^-9); correlation is twice the bias. A fixed key XOR offset can flip the parity sign, so this is not a universal post-key zero-parity probability or the probability that the correct counter wins.
Section6.1 Step4: six fixed ciphertext-byte differences, source conditional selection fraction from the structure pair pool.
Section6.1 Step5a: source count2^80*m to2^48*m, conditional on this guessed material and previous filters.
Section6.1 Step5b: source count2^48*m to2^16*m, conditional on the preceding stage.
Section6.1 Step5di: source count2^16*m to m, conditional on the preceding stage.
Section6.1 Step5dii: source count m to2^-16*m, conditional on the preceding stage.
Section6.1 Step5diii: source count2^-16*m to2^-32*m, conditional on the preceding stage. With m=2^53 this gives2^21 counted pairs, not a ranking success rate.

review.scope: Exact-edition endpoint-specific success audit. Local collision, table-hit, conditional retention and filter events are separate from recovery success or distinguishing advantage. Existing costs, targets, settings, conflicts and full-audit gates remain unchanged.
